gaps.description: GOAL_READING is measured by word-reading accuracy (at least 95% across three consecutive curriculum-based probes), and both IEPs say progress will be measured with oral reading fluency and word-reading accuracy probes. No supplied document reports a word-reading accuracy result: there is no baseline, and the only progress result (2026-01-23) is oral reading fluency in WCPM. A record of the word-reading accuracy probe results would answer this.

tripwires.description: L003 reviewed reference has zero conflicts; grader must not accept conflict claims.
Do not treat 3 sessions/week as operative before 2026-04-01 or from Q1/Q2 reports.
Do not give 2026-03-25 (amended IEP date) as the service start date.
Do not report 88 WCPM as accuracy or progress toward the 95% target.
5 vs 3 sessions/week is a dated service change, not a conflict.
Do not report goal, eligibility, accommodations, session length, location, or IEP period changed.
Do not report ORF on 2026-03-18/25 or any score other than 88 WCPM.
Do not call SLD a medical diagnosis.

Do not say increased general education time was adopted or implemented.
